name: tag-input
title: Tag Input
summary: A field that turns what people type into removable tags.
use_when: A short free list: labels, keywords, email addresses
Values people both add and take away again in one field
avoid_when: Picking from a known list: use Combobox or a group of ChipToggles

props.max: number: the most tags it takes
props.placeholder: string, shown while there are no tags
props.label: string: the accessible name, e.g. "Tags"
props.name: string: submits the tags with a form, joined by commas

copy.tag: As typed; one or two words
copy.description: Say how to add: "Press Enter or comma to add a tag"

a11y: Enter or comma adds, Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag, pasting a list adds each item
Every remove button is named after its tag: "Remove Design"
